heroHeadline: ICE Arrests Nearly 40,000 Immigrants Across New York and New Jersey
heroSubtitle: New data maps the geographic breakdown of nearly 40,000 ICE arrests across New York and New Jersey, revealing the scale and concentration of interior enforcement operations in the northeast. The figures add to the record-setting pace of immigration arrests under the Trump administration's second-term enforcement surge.
